title: Slice bound on a convex set: ∫⁻_Q∫⁻_Q g((1 − t)y + tx) ≤ 2ⁿ Lⁿ(Q) ∫⁻_Q g
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ := Euclid n with Lebesgue measure Lⁿ (volume), Q ⊆ ℝⁿ convex and measurable, g : ℝⁿ → [0, ∞] measurable, and t ∈ [0, 1]. Then ∫⁻_{x∈Q} ∫⁻_{y∈Q} g((1 − t)y + tx) dy dx ≤ 2ⁿ · Lⁿ(Q) · ∫⁻_Q g. All integrals are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞] (outer variable x, inner variable y), and the right side is computed in [0, ∞] with 0 · ∞ = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid n → ℝ≥0∞), Convex ℝ Q → MeasurableSet Q → Measurable g → ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫⁻ x in Q, ∫⁻ y in Q, g ((1 - t) • y + t • x) ≤ 2 ^ n * volume Q * ∫⁻ z in Q, g z
